description: This file defines classes and structures for handling F1AP procedures in a 5G network, including UE context management, paging, RRC context creation, and interface management within the OCUDU project.

classes.name: f1ap_ue_context_manager
classes.description: Abstract class for managing UE context procedures such as setup, release, modification, and ID updates.

classes.name: f1ap_paging_manager
classes.description: Interface for handling F1AP paging procedures.

classes.name: ue_rrc_context_creation_request
classes.description: Structure representing a request to create an RRC context for a UE.

classes.name: ue_rrc_context_creation_response
classes.description: Structure representing the response to an RRC context creation request.

classes.name: ue_rrc_context_creation_outcome
classes.description: Expected type for the outcome of RRC context creation.

classes.name: f1ap_common_du_task_notifier
classes.description: Interface for scheduling F1AP async tasks.

classes.name: f1ap_du_processor_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying the DU processor about F1AP events.

classes.name: f1ap_interface_management_handler
classes.description: Interface for handling F1AP interface management procedures.

classes.name: f1ap_cu
classes.description: Main class combining all F1AP handling functionalities for the CU, including message handling, UE context management, statistics, paging, and interface management.
